title: Electrified CO2 uptake in quinone-based covalent organic frameworks

compounds.name: DADOP-TFP
compounds.quote: we developed optimized conditions to synthesize a quinone-based COF, DADOP-TFP, which is composed of 2,7-diaminophenanthrene-9,10-dione (DADOP monomer) and 2,4,6-trihydroxybenzene-1,3,5-tricarbaldehyde (TFP)

compounds.name: 2,7-diaminophenanthrene-9,10-dione
compounds.quote: the E1/2 increased from −0.469 V for the amine monomer (2,7-diaminophenanthrene-9,10-dione) to +0.095 V for the COF

compounds.name: DADOP-TRI
compounds.quote: three quinone-based COFs (DADOP-TRI, DADOP-TCA, and DAAQ-TFP, where TRI is 4,4′,4′′-(1,3,5-triazine-2,4,6-triyl)tribenzaldehyde

compounds.name: DADOP-TCA
compounds.quote: three quinone-based COFs (DADOP-TRI, DADOP-TCA, and DAAQ-TFP, where TRI is 4,4′,4′′-(1,3,5-triazine-2,4,6-triyl)tribenzaldehyde, TCA is benzene-1,3,5-tricarbaldehyde

compounds.name: DAAQ-TFP
compounds.quote: DAAQ-TFP, where TRI is 4,4′,4′′-(1,3,5-triazine-2,4,6-triyl)tribenzaldehyde, TCA is benzene-1,3,5-tricarbaldehyde, and DAAQ is 2,6-diaminoanthracene-9,10-dione

compounds.name: DADOP-QF-TFP
compounds.quote: a quinone-free analog of DADOP-TFP (denoted as DADOP-QF-TFP), which were each synthesized on at least an 800-mg scale
